map.机场净空保护区内，建筑高度受航空限高控制：H_limit = 跑道标高 H0 +: Inside an airport obstacle limitation zone, building height is governed by the aviation height limit: H_limit = runway elevation H0 + distance to runway end L × takeoff/approach slope − safety clearance; exceeding it means no construction is permitted.
map.已知规划限高，反算可建楼层数：层数 = 限高 ÷ 层高（取整数层），用于方案初期: Given the planned height limit, back-calculate the buildable floors: floors = height limit ÷ floor height (take the integer floor count), which is used for early massing studies of a scheme.
map.北纬 30° 城市（auto 间距系数 L=1.2），南侧已有建筑与用地边界的日:
A city at 30°N (auto spacing coefficient L=1.2), the daylight spacing from existing southern buildings to the site boundary is D=40 m, and the planned floor height is 3 m:
H_max = D / L = 40 / 1.2 = 33.33 m; buildable floors = 33.33 / 3 ≈ 11.1 → take 11 floors (actual height 33.0 m).
If moved to a city at 45°N (L=1.8), H_max = 40 / 1.8 = 22.22 m and only 7 floors can be built. Clearly, at higher latitudes the buildable height under the same spacing is significantly lower.
map.某机场跑道标高 H0=50 m，地块距跑道端 L=2000 m，起降航段坡度 s:
For an airport with runway elevation H0=50 m, the parcel is L=2000 m from the runway end, the takeoff/approach segment slope is 0.015 (1.5%), and safety clearance is 10 m:
H_limit = 50 + 2000 × 0.015 − 10 = 50 + 30 − 10 = 70 m.
That is, buildings on the parcel must not exceed 70 m (about 23 floors @3 m); exceeding it requires coordination with the air traffic authority or a route realignment.
